evidence.observation: Pressure held steady at about 3.03-3.08 Torr at 100 sccm through the ramp and was 3.066 Torr at the start of growth.
Pressure rose steadily from 3.066 to 3.377 Torr over 480 s of growth and is still climbing.
Argon flow stayed at setpoint (99.3-100.4 sccm), so the pressure rise is not caused by extra argon.
Temperature is holding 750 °C at about 44% heater power, which looks normal.
The exhaust O2 sensor is not installed, so I can't check whether air is getting in.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a check that isolates the tube and watches whether pressure keeps rising, would show whether this is a seal leak (air getting in) or an exhaust or pump blockage. A throttle-valve or pump status reading would also help.
